# watchpoint_event_subscription (Resource)

A subscription on the unified event bus: every event of the chosen types is POSTed, HMAC-signed, to `url`. Requires the `unified_event_bus` feature and `settings.manage`. The signing secret is returned only at creation and on rotation, so it is stored in state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Deliver alert and incident events to your own endpoint. Verify each
# delivery with the signing secret.
resource "watchpoint_event_subscription" "ops_bus" {
  name        = "Ops event bus"
  url         = "https://events.example.com/watchpoint"
  event_types = ["alert.triggered", "alert.resolved", "incident.opened"]
}

output "ops_bus_signing_secret" {
  value     = watchpoint_event_subscription.ops_bus.signing_secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `event_types` (Set of String) Event types to deliver, from the catalog at `GET /identity/event-catalog` (for example `alert.triggered`, `incident.opened`). At least one.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `url` (String) HTTPS endpoint the events are delivered to. Private and metadata addresses are refused.

### Optional

- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether deliveries are sent. The platform turns a subscription off after repeated failures; setting this back to `true` re-enables it. Defaults to `true`.
- `rotate_trigger` (String) Arbitrary value that rotates `signing_secret` when it changes.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Subscription ID.
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) HMAC signing secret for verifying deliveries. Not recoverable by import.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_event_subscription.ops_bus evs_001
```
